data.summary: The first multi-view character sheet appears before a dissolve into the street. Both fighters later approach and end with readable blades, but the camera crops away their lower bodies. Dense action frames show an empty-hand interception before the blue-blade clash, making the requested single blue-dagger block uncertain.

observations.text: The character sheet occupies the opening and dissolves into the street with ghosted extra views of the first woman.

The fighters approach. At frames 68–73 the masked woman meets the attack with her free arm while her blue weapon is behind her head; the blue blade then sweeps forward into contact at frames 78–79. This is not an unambiguous single blue-dagger block.
A progressive push-in ends on heads and upper torsos. The two blades are distinct and clear of faces, but the required full-body continuous lateral shot is lost.

data.review_scope: All 120 sequential thumbnails, original frames 0 and 119, and enlarged original-frame crops 64–79 inspected against the three original references. No listening or normal-speed playback judgment.
